Download the e-file 990-PF grants-paid extracts

Source: R/efilepf.R
pf_efilepf_download.Rd

Downloads to a staging name and renames on success, so an interrupted run never leaves a truncated file that a later run would treat as complete — the same discipline pf_schedi_download() uses.

Usage

pf_efilepf_download(
  dir = pf_efilepf_dir(),
  years = pf_efilepf_years(),
  version = "efilepf_v3_1",
  table = pf_efilepf_table(),
  overwrite = FALSE,
  verbose = TRUE
)

Arguments

dir

Destination directory. Defaults to ~/Documents/grants/efilepf, deliberately outside the package and outside any synced folder: the full set is several GB.

years, version, table

Passed to pf_efilepf_url().

overwrite

Re-download files that already exist.

verbose

Print progress.

Value

Character vector of local paths, invisibly.
